I'm fairly sure this is localized boundary detachment on the optical probe (common with this model if the flow pattern shifts during the feed ramp). Do your readings of the same telemetry point you the same direction?
I'll pull the 500L telemetry and our prior notes so I can check whether the DO crash, power spike, and flat exhaust CO₂ actually line up with a probe-boundary artifact.

I'll check the 500L traces and the probe failure envelope against that 90-second power climb, then compare gas-phase vs DO. I'll start with the batch notes and any telemetry we already have.

I’ll check whether we actually have the 500L traces and probe notes, then I’ll answer the CO₂ vs hypoxia point against that — not from memory of a chart I haven’t seen.
